message.content:
This editorial illustration features a red background with a grainy texture. At the top, the black text "TEMPO" is prominent above the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Further up, smaller text reads "LIPUTAN KHUSUS TIGA TAHUN PEMERINTAHAN JOKOWI". Centered is the large white headline "PONTANG-PANTING INFRASTRUKTUR", followed by black text: "MENGGENJOT PEMBANGUNAN FISIK, PRESIDEN JOKOWI DIPUJI DAN DICACI. DARI AKROBAT PENDANAAN HINGGA TUDINGAN PENCITRAAN."

The illustration depicts a figure dressed as a construction worker in a white hard hat, light-colored long-sleeved shirt, dark pants, and white boots. The figure is bent forward with hands on knees, standing atop grey stone-textured steps. This figure looks toward a tall, grey, rectangular podium positioned to the right. The podium has a microphone attached to its flat top. The worker is positioned lower than the podium's height. In the background, dark silhouettes of cranes and buildings under construction are visible. Wisps of grey smoke or fabric-like shapes float around. A barcode and "6-12 NOVEMBER 2017" with pricing details appear in the bottom right corner.
